Questions

What owners ask before the first call.

What is Legacy AI?

A one-stop technical partner for owner-operated businesses. Instead of hiring a web person, an IT person, a receptionist and a marketing agency, you hire one team that owns the result — one call, one person, one bill. Legacy AI is led by founder Douglas Talley from Brown County, Indiana.

Who is it for?

Businesses with customers: auto body and collision shops, plumbers, HVAC and contractors, chiropractic and wellness offices, restaurants and hospitality, professional services, property inspection, and more. If your business has a repetitive, expensive, annoying part, we can probably build for it.

Are these custom projects or ready-made?

Everything in the dossier is already built, already deployed and already producing results. You are reading a menu: pick what hurts, and we configure the solution around your business, your branding and your workflow.

What does it cost, and how does payment work?

We agree on scope, price and timeline in writing before work begins. Most projects begin with a deposit, and payments follow the agreed schedule with milestones for larger projects. Service trades, advertising exchanges and combined arrangements are welcome.

How fast can we get started?

Step one is a 30-minute call about what is broken. Once we agree on the plan, the build is one working session, and we go live together on day one. After that: monthly reports, quarterly reviews and ongoing improvements.

What happens to my customer data?

The contact-list health check runs entirely in your browser — your CSV, customer rows and audit results stay on your device. When you send a message, only the contact details and the request in the form go to Douglas; no email is sent automatically.
